name: 30-day mortality
description: Facility-level mortality indicator summarizing outcomes after selected inpatient episodes.
methodology: Shown as an illustrative percentage trend aligned with CMS public reporting concepts and described in plain language for SEO-friendly interpretation.

name: 30-day readmissions
description: Readmission performance for target conditions, often used in HRRP analysis.
methodology: Displayed as a longitudinal trend sourced from the versioned snapshot and explained alongside HRRP program context.

name: Hospital complications
description: Complication-oriented hospital quality measure family that can be compared over time.
methodology: Mapped to exploratory intervention and device narratives rather than patient-level causal claims.

name: Patient experience
description: Consumer-oriented hospital experience score using public CMS reporting concepts.
methodology: Included as a high-level score to balance outcomes, safety, and patient-centered quality.
